sections.heading: Overview
sections.source_text: # iPhone 6 - Technical Specifications

sections.heading: Finish
sections.source_text:
- Silver
- Gold
- Space Gray

sections.heading: Weight and Dimensions2
sections.source_text:
- Height: 5.44 inches (138.1 mm)
- Width: 2.64 inches (67.0 mm)
- Depth:0.27 inch (6.9 mm)
- Weight: 4.55 ounces (129 grams)

sections.heading: Display
sections.source_text:
- Retina HD display
- 4.7-inch (diagonal) LED-backlit widescreen Multi‑Touch display with IPS technology
- 1334-by-750-pixel resolution at 326 ppi
- 1400:1 contrast ratio (typical)
- 500 cd/m2 max brightness (typical)
- Full sRGB standard
- Dual-domain pixels for wide viewing angles
- Fingerprint-resistant oleophobic coating on front
- Support for display of multiple languages and characters simultaneously
- Display Zoom
- Reachability

sections.heading: Chips
sections.source_text:
- A8 chip with 64-bit architecture
- M8 motion coprocessor

sections.source_text:

- Sapphire crystal lens cover
- Auto image stabilization
- Auto HDR for photos
- Face detection
- Exposure control

sections.heading: Audio Playback
sections.source_text:
- Audio formats supported: AAC (8 to 320 Kbps), Protected AAC (from iTunes Store), HE-AAC, MP3 (8 to 320 Kbps), MP3 VBR, Audible (formats 2, 3, 4, Audible Enhanced Audio, AAX, and AAX+), Apple Lossless, AIFF, and WAV

sections.heading: TV and Video
sections.source_text:
- AirPlay Mirroring, photos, audio, and video out to Apple TV (2nd generation or later)
- Video mirroring and video out support: Up to 1080p through Lightning Digital AV Adapter and Lightning to VGA Adapter (adapters sold separately)
- Video formats supported: H.264 video up to 1080p, 60 frames per second, High Profile level 4.2 with AAC-LC audio up to 160 Kbps, 48kHz, stereo audio in .m4v, .mp4, and .mov file formats; MPEG-4 video up to 2.5 Mbps, 640 by 480 pixels, 30 frames per second, Simple Profile with AAC-LC audio up to 160 Kbps per channel, 48kHz, stereo audio in .m4v, .mp4, and .mov file formats; Motion JPEG (M-JPEG) up to 35 Mbps, 1280 by 720 pixels, 30 frames per second, audio in ulaw, PCM stereo audio in .avi file format

sections.heading: System Requirements
sections.source_text:
- Apple ID (required for some features)
- Internet access8

Syncing with iTunes on a Mac or PC requires:

- Mac: OS X v10.8.5 or later
- PC: Windows 7 or later
- iTunes 12.3 or later (free download from [www.itunes.com/uk/download](http://www.itunes.com/uk/download))

sections.source_text:

- Relative humidity: 5% to 95% noncondensing
- Operating altitude: tested up to 10,000 feet (3000 m)

sections.heading: iPhone and the Environment
sections.source_text:
Apple takes a complete product life cycle approach to determining our environmental impact. [Learn more about iPhone and the Environment](https://www.apple.com/uk/environment/)

iPhone 6 and iPhone 6 Plus embody Apple’s continuing environmental progress. They are designed with the following features to reduce environmental impact:

- Mercury-free LED-backlit display
- Arsenic-free display glass
- Brominated flame retardant-free
- PVC-free
- Beryllium-free
- Recyclable aluminum enclosure
- Power adapter outperforms strictest global energy efficiency standards
- Speaker enclosure with 30 percent post-consumer recycled plastic

**Apple and the Environment**

[Learn more about Apple’s dedication to reducing the environmental impact of our products and process](https://www.apple.com/uk/environment/). Or read our [Product Environmental Reports](http://www.apple.com/uk/environment/reports/) for detailed information on the environmental performance of every Apple product.

**Recycling**

Apple takes a holistic view of materials management and waste minimization. [Learn more about how to recycle your iPhone.](https://www.apple.com/uk/shop/trade-in)
